doc.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021

title: Drummer of most distinction: Elvin Jones
summary: He guesses drummers would name Elvin Jones, ahead of Buddy Rich and Tony Williams.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Fantastic. Last question. If you had a convention of drummers sitting around having a few drinks who do they talk about as the drummer of most distinction?
Wow. You know I’m going to take a stab here and say most distinction probably, and it’s my generation, they’re probably going to say Elvin Jones. Probably going to say Elvin. I

mean it could be Buddy Rich, who I admired greatly. It could be Tony Williams. But overall in terms of shaping the sound and the feel of the drums and setting the course for the next generation and beyond, Elvin Jones’s impact is monumental. I would venture a guess that it would be Elvin.
Wow. I saw him live once and he made an impact on me. I mean he was fierce when he was playing and yeah, talk about communication, it was there.
